text: Aakash Harpalani, Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Director of Clean Energy, will provide an introduction to the program Toronto Atmospheric Fund is developing to accelerate the deployment of solar electricity generation in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, including the target market, key elements of the turnkey design, potential partnerships, and value proposition of this distributed energy resource for the local and provincial grid, utilities, ratepayers, business, and achieving climate objectives.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the item for information.
